reference: YouTube NTrzxPIXer4 (Kubold FPP Melee Animset - Two Handed Sword), 1080p60. Guard = file 110.94-111.40 s raise + hold (user window 1:49-1:52); GuardHit = 117.64-118.39 s; GuardBreak = 119.70-120.15 s
screen: Full 1920x1080 reference pixels. B = blade base (blade centreline at the crossguard). angle = blade screen angle in degrees, 0 = pointing right, 90 = up. camera: Matched in normalised screen coordinates with the game's 75 deg vertical FOV, 16:9; the reference camera does not move during any of these clips.

hold.roll_note: crossguard upright on screen like the reference (flat towards the viewer). raise.note: progress from OUR idle to the hold; angle progress from the reference blade angle (75.8 deg idle -> 42.1 hold), position progress from the crossguard hook (x leads, y lags)
